SELECT major.college, SUM(income.amount) AS total_income_amount, SUM(income.amount) * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(amount) FROM income) AS fraction_of_total_income
FROM income
JOIN member ON income.link_to_member = member.member_id
JOIN major ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id
GROUP BY major.college;
